name: Dubstep
blurb: Half-speed drums and a bass that wobbles.

sounds.name: Wobble bass
sounds.why: A held saw note whose filter opens and closes in time with the track. The speed of the wobble is the rhythm of the bassline.

ingredients.name: A held sawtooth
ingredients.adds: One long, buzzy bass note per bar.

ingredients.name: Close the filter
ingredients.adds: Most of the buzz is removed.

ingredients.name: Wobble it
ingredients.adds: The cutoff rises and falls a set number of times each bar.

knobs.label: wobble top
knobs.above: A harsh buzz at the top of each wobble.

knobs.label: wobbles per bar
knobs.below: A slow swell, not a wobble.
knobs.above: A flutter too fast to feel as rhythm.

ingredients.name: Resonance
ingredients.adds: A whistling peak that rides up and down with the wobble.

knobs.label: resonance
knobs.above: The whistle is louder than the bass.

pitfalls: The same wobble speed for a whole track gets dull. Change it every bar or two.

sounds.name: Half-time drums
sounds.why: The tempo is 140, but the snare lands only on beat 3, so it feels like 70. All that empty space is for the bass.

ingredients.name: Kick on 1, snare on 3
ingredients.adds: Two hits a bar, from the default kit.

ingredients.name: The 909
ingredients.adds: A hard kick and a loud, cracking snare.

ingredients.name: Extra kicks
ingredients.adds: A kick just before the snare and one at the very end of the bar.
ingredients.listenFor: The beat starts to lurch forward.

ingredients.name: Hats
ingredients.adds: Eighth-note hats that keep the real tempo going.
ingredients.listenFor: You can now hear both speeds at once: fast hats, slow snare.

ingredients.name: A big empty room
ingredients.adds: Reverb on the kick and snare.

knobs.label: reverb
knobs.above: The space between hits fills up.

sounds.why: A long, clean sine under the wobble. The wobble is the character; this is the weight.

sounds.name: Dark pad
sounds.why: A cold, distant chord for the intro and breakdown, before the bass arrives.

sounds.name: Dub siren
sounds.why: A tone that swings up and down in pitch, fed into an echo. It came to dubstep from Jamaican sound systems.

ingredients.name: A square wave
ingredients.adds: A hollow, steady beep held for a bar.

ingredients.name: Swing the pitch
ingredients.adds: The pitch rises and falls several times a second.

ingredients.name: Soften it
ingredients.adds: Takes the edge off the square wave.

ingredients.name: Long echo
ingredients.adds: The siren repeats and trails off.

knobs.label: feedback
knobs.below: It stops when the note stops.

sounds.why: The hit on the first beat of the drop, after a bar of silence.
